scope: Design-policy simulation only; no runtime ranking or medical gold label

policies.A: strongest trusted grade, P > H > none; location gates Main only
policies.B: one strongest grade per axis, lexicographic [P axis count, H axis count, weak axis count]
policies.C: one strongest grade per axis, Pareto non-dominated Main set; incomparable candidates stay tied
policies.D: EXPERIMENT ONLY: per-axis grade P=3/H=2/weak=1, sorted and weighted 10/6/3

definitions.counts: Each of 672 distinct location/side/movement-set answers has equal mathematical weight; not a usage prevalence estimate
definitions.candidateZero: No displayed Main or Additional, including weak/stretch references
definitions.top1: Unique ranked result only; tied membership is separate
definitions.crossGroup: Compare each rankable Additional to each top Main; case flags can overlap among greater/equal/incomparable
definitions.confidence: Design evidence of task involvement, never diagnostic probability
definitions.statusPrecedence: Unknown movement or location -> insufficient; no Main and only stretch -> stretch_only_reference; no Main otherwise -> insufficient; Main -> ranked/tied
definitions.position: P/S are Main eligibility only; R/U never hard-exclude a candidate
definitions.side: Symptom side retained but not ranked; directional movement uses symmetric relation cells
